instructions: Put the 8 eggs in a medium pot and cover them with cold water by 1 inch. Bring the water to a hard boil over high heat.
Turn the heat down to medium and boil for 7 minutes. Set a timer so the yolks stay just set and a little creamy in the middle.

Meanwhile, whisk the 3/4 cup mayonnaise with the Dijon, 1 tbsp lemon juice, the pepper and a pinch of salt until smooth. Taste it. If it's flat, add a little more lemon juice or a pinch of salt. Chop 2 tbsp chives.
Drain the eggs and run cold water over them for 2 minutes. Let them sit in a bowl of cold water for 5 minutes, then peel them.
Cut the eggs in half lengthwise and set them cut side down on plates, 4 halves each. Spoon the mayonnaise over them and scatter the chives on top. Serve cold.
method_notes: Taste with the Eyes' Oeufs Mayonnaise is the lead: eggs boiled 7 minutes after a hard boil, chilled, halved and covered in a Dijon and lemon mayonnaise with chives. It has no rating, so this is a fallback lead. Of its two mayonnaise methods the commercial one is used (no raw egg, and quicker); the rice vinegar and the flowers are left out. Pariseater's version (9 minutes, homemade mayonnaise) was read for comparison. There's no baguette, to keep it gluten-free.
